openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Saturday’s gate is clear — not the inbox. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Competitive calm. Fierce. Unbeatable. Own the threshold from the first breath.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not fill an empty Saturday board just to feel busy. Fierce calm is weekend composure under a clear sky: charge first, body second, two clean must-dos, quiet admin only after the morning has already won. Competitive. Unbeatable. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Saturday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Clear outside; tempo inside. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: A clear sky is not a summons
items.body: Saturday light is not a work order. Hermetic operators use an empty board as a seal, not a hole to fill. What you do not open cannot leak into the weekend.

items.hed: The gate closes before the noise
items.body: Breath draws the ring. Body stands inside it. Mail may enter only after both are done. An unsealed morning follows you into the afternoon.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.hed: An empty court is still a court
grimoire.body: Solomon did not summon counsel because the hall was quiet. A sealed circle with nothing inside is a finished working. Your Saturday morning is that hall: breath draws the ring, body stands inside it, then you may leave the gate shut.
grimoire.practice: After four rounds of box breathing, name the two must-dos out loud. Then start the 3-minute opener. Do not open mail until both are done.

lesson.oneLiner: One weekly repeat. Tools for read and draft. A human gate before anything leaves the building.
beats: Task — pick one boring repeat, not a life operating system.
Tools — read files, search, send a draft. Stop there.
Gate — human checkpoint before send, delete, or pay.
Loop — run it, watch it, tighten it. Do not add tools mid-flight.
Rule: a free guide is a brief, not a deployment order.
lesson.takeaway: Operator leverage is the gate, not the swarm. @mmmik000: brief → gate → review. Then get back to the board.
